sourceText: Preserve existing service using reserved capacity, block unsafe transitions, and report unsupported demand explicitly.
title: Quota or maximum-capacity exhaustion
objective: Exhaust a declared allowance, reject unsafe expansion and promotion, and measure preserved or interrupted reserved service without claiming an Azure quota event.
infrastructure: N/A: resource-free offline lesson; no IaC or resource operations.
preconditions: Two protected reserved units on reserved-v1
Two synthetic journeys per unit per window
Total harness allowance includes reserved and sandbox units
Sandbox admission alone does not establish readiness
actions: Apply bounded configuration before the first action
Probe reserved service using one declared observation fixture
expectedAssertions: Exhaustion fills only the declared total allowance while two reserved units remain protected
Unsafe expansion is rejected by the harness admission limit, never labeled a native quota observation
Unallocated targets cannot be promoted and reserved-v1 routing remains unchanged
Unsupported new demand and withheld admitted sandbox demand are explicitly unserved
Actual synthetic reserved-journey samples determine PASS, FAIL, or UNKNOWN
Earlier failures and unknowns remain cumulative after later healthy samples and in archived history
limits: Allowance 3-6 total units; unsafe extra request 1-3; budget 100-500 ms, whole integers
Three ordered safety actions and at most three four-journey probes per run
Four page-memory archived runs with explicit pruning; no reload persistence
No native Azure, production runtime, source-parent, or reliability certification
acceptance: Parent-owned empirical acceptance pending; this is one frozen S unit, not worker-awarded Done.
